new.n: Old miser's $10,000 said concealed on the farm, La Crosse River NE of La Crosse
new.pl: 1874 county map: his strip at the W edge of sec 14 T16N R7W (Campbell Twp), from the La Crosse River across the railway; c.1915 plat shows the sister on the same ground. No house mark.
new.v: Something over $10,000 said concealed on the farm
new.st: A wealthy old La Crosse County farmer and miser died in March 1903 amid a lawsuit over a claimed marriage. When his $20,000 estate was settled out of court in May 1904, his sister took the farm and it was said that something over $10,000 was concealed on it, with the sister thought to know the hiding place. Pin is on the 1874 strip, not the spot itself.
new.t: One dispatch, rumour only; the family may have recovered it quietly. River floodplain land. Private: permission.
